body:
## Description
Holdings synced from certain third-party brokerage connections (e.g., Zerodha) may reflect data up to 2 hours out of date rather than near-real-time, due to aggregator API polling intervals. Does not affect manually entered holdings or bank transaction sync.

## Impact
- Portfolio value and XIRR shown may lag market-hours pricing by up to 2 hours
- No data loss or incorrect transaction records - display latency only

## Planned Resolution
Investigate webhook-based sync with aggregator to replace polling, targeted for v1.1. Until resolved, will be disclosed in Release Notes and via in-app sync-status indicator.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Known issue documented in v1.0 Release Notes under "Known Issues" section
- [ ] In-app "Last synced: [time]" label visible on affected holdings
title: [Known Issue] Delayed Sync for Linked Brokerage Holdings

body:
## Description
When navigating back from Onboarding Step 4 (Savings Goal) to Step 3 (Monthly Expenses), previously adjusted expense category sliders reset to default values instead of retaining user input.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. In Onboarding Step 3, adjust one or more category sliders from default
2. Proceed to Step 4
3. Click "Back" to return to Step 3

## Expected Result
Slider values reflect previously entered amounts

## Actual Result
Sliders reset to default values

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Step 3 sliders persist exactly when navigating forward then back
- [ ] State persistence verified for all 5 categories (Housing, Food & Groceries, Transport, Utilities, Entertainment)
title: [Bug] Onboarding Step 3 Slider Values Reset on Back Navigation

body:
## Description
Some users receive two identical bill reminder notifications for the same recurring bill instance instead of one, for bills configured with "3-day advance notice" preference.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Enable "Bill reminders" in Settings > Notifications
2. Have a recurring bill due within 3-day advance window
3. Observe notification delivery

## Expected Result
Exactly one reminder sent per bill instance

## Actual Result
Two identical reminders sent for same bill instance

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Exactly one notification delivered per bill instance per user
- [ ] Regression test added to notification dispatch to prevent duplicates on retry
title: [Bug] Duplicate Recurring Bill Reminder Notifications

body:
## Description
Category and total budget values above ?1,00,000 display incorrect rounding (off-by-one-rupee or truncated paise), causing spent/remaining figures to not reconcile with transaction sum.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Set category budget with spent value exceeding ?1,00,000
2. Observe displayed "spent" total on Budget page
3. Compare against manually summed transaction list

## Expected Result
Displayed total exactly matches sum of transactions using Indian digit grouping

## Actual Result
Displayed total is rounded/truncated incorrectly

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Category with spend > ?1,00,000 displays value matching exact transaction sum to the rupee
title: [Bug] Budget Totals Round Incorrectly Above ?1,00,000

## Description
Enhance Budget module: when categories exceed limits, surface AI-generated recommendation for reallocating from underspent categories with one-click "Auto-rebalance" for Pro/Family users.

## Requirements
- AI insight banner when ?1 category over limit with exact overage and suggested source
- "Auto-rebalance" action triggers immediate reallocation (Pro/Family only)
- Over-budget categories flagged with color and icon (not color alone)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] 2+ over-budget categories display in AI banner with specific reallocation amount
- [ ] Pro/Family clicking "Auto-rebalance" updates immediately with confirmation toast
- [ ] Free-tier sees insight text without action button
title: [Enhancement] AI-Assisted Budget Auto-Rebalancing

body:
## Description
Introduce an Investments module for consolidated holdings (mutual funds, stocks, gold bonds, debt funds) with portfolio-level performance metrics and AI-driven rebalancing alerts.

## Requirements
- Portfolio summary: total value, total invested, total return (%), XIRR
- Holdings table: name, type, units, NAV, value, return %
- CSV export of holdings
- AI rebalancing alert when allocation deviates from target
- Feature gated to Pro and Family tiers

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Portfolio summary and holdings table render sorted by value (descending)
- [ ] AI rebalancing alert displays with specific rupee amount when equity exceeds target
- [ ] CSV export downloads and matches on-screen values exactly
title: [Feature] Investment Portfolio Tracking

body:
## Description
Introduce a conversational AI Advisor accessible from the dashboard sidebar. The advisor answers natural-language financial questions using the user's actual transaction, budget, goal, and investment data, returning specific, numeric, actionable guidance.

## Requirements
- Chat interface with message history, suggested starter questions
- Typing/processing indicator while response is generated
- AI responses use accent (purple) styling per Brand Style Guide
- Entry points from Overview, Budget, and Investments views
- Feature gated to Pro and Family subscription tiers only

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Pro/Family user clicking "Ask AI advisor" opens chat with welcome message and starter chips
- [ ] Typing indicator displays minimum 800ms before response renders
- [ ] Free-tier users see upgrade prompt instead of chat interface
- [ ] AI-generated message bubbles render with purple accent styling
title: [Feature] AI Financial Advisor Chat Interface
